definitions.context_dispersion: absolute report F/E deviation from its incident report median
definitions.measurement_missingness: membership in observable missing_fields before locked zero imputation
definitions.numeric_summary: finite observations; R-7 linear quantiles; MAD is median absolute deviation from the median
definitions.pairwise_jaccard: intersection / union for report membership sets
definitions.pairwise_overlap_coefficient: intersection / smaller set size; empty smaller sets excluded
definitions.population_reuse_rate: 1 - unique represented members / member occurrences, per incident
definitions.reported_measurement_views: after_locked_imputation is the inference-visible distribution; observed_only excludes reports whose missing_fields mask names that measurement

purpose: method-agnostic descriptive profile of frozen candidate data
